# Feishu Doc Designer

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Irennnne/feishu-doc-designer

Feishu Doc Designer is an open-source AI Agent Skill that converts local Markdown into restrained, polished native Feishu/Lark documents and publishes them through the official lark-cli.

Use it for:
- Markdown to Feishu / Markdown to Lark Docs
- 飞书文档美化 / Markdown 转飞书文档
- Native callouts, short-phrase highlights, tables, code blocks, images, attachments
- Mermaid diagrams converted into editable Feishu whiteboards
- Direct creation in a user folder, Wiki node, or Wiki space

Do not use it for:
- SEO or GEO rewriting of user documents
- Feishu instant-message formatting
- Replacing or synchronizing an existing Feishu document in v0.1
- Browser HTML/CSS layouts

Primary instructions: SKILL.md
Design rules: references/design-system.md
XML contract: references/lark-xml-contract.md
Setup and authentication: references/publishing.md
Chinese documentation: README.md
English documentation: README.en.md

Invocation example:
Use $feishu-doc-designer to publish ./document.md as a polished Feishu document.
